Section navigation.copy: Uses Tabs for workspace section selection while preserving controlled and uncontrolled selection state.

Preference management.copy: Delegates settings groups, form sections, validation, save/reset, and danger confirmation to Preference Management.

Settings Workspace.standard: This template is the full product settings workspace and composes governed preference patterns instead of owning controls directly.
Settings Workspace.screenSystem: The screen system separates settings section navigation from preference content while keeping state, density, and danger confirmation in the Flow cascade.
Settings Workspace.informationArchitecture: Navigation follows settings work: profile, notifications, theme mode, security details, and danger-zone actions.
Settings Workspace.primary: User updates workspace preferences, saves changes, and confirms risky settings actions without leaving the governed Flow surface.
qualityGates: Section selection keeps Tabs, root state, and preference content synchronized.
Settings controls are delegated to Preference Management and Settings, not locally rendered by the template.
Danger-zone behavior is delegated to Confirmation Dialog through Preference Management.

patternDetails.Preference Management: Owns settings groups, Form Section blocks, Settings controls, Confirmation Dialog, save/reset, validation, permission, and danger-zone state.

Docs Shell Template.standard: This template is the documentation shell: navigation, search, responsive sidebar, theme, and page chrome must be composed through governed Flow patterns.
Docs Shell Template.screenSystem: The shell keeps global navigation, local navigation, search disclosure, and page content as one governed product surface.
Docs Shell Template.informationArchitecture: Navigation separates global actions in Topbar from content taxonomy in Sidebar.
Docs Shell Template.primary: User moves through FlowDocs while preserving search, section navigation, theme, density, and responsive sidebar behavior.
qualityGates: Topbar and Sidebar are consumed from Flow, not reimplemented by docs CSS or DOM mutation.
Search results remain keyboard navigable and do not create nested local surfaces.
Mobile sidebar opens and closes through the same hamburger control.

patternDetails.Topbar: Owns global shell actions, search entry, theme/density controls, and responsive layout.
patternDetails.Sidebar: Owns taxonomy navigation, disclosure, active item, and mobile drawer behavior.
patternDetails.Search: Owns search input, results, empty state, and keyboard navigation.
patternDetails.Command Palette: Owns command discovery and shortcut-style navigation.
patternDetails.Documentation Page Shell: Owns docs page chrome and content mounting boundaries.

Docs Home Template.standard: This template is the FlowDocs landing page and must use Flow documentation patterns for hero, editorial sections, metadata, and navigation into the system.
Docs Home Template.screenSystem: The home page introduces system coverage, status, migration, and architecture without inventing local card, hero, or background systems.
Docs Home Template.informationArchitecture: Content moves from system status to layer navigation to migration and architecture evidence.
Docs Home Template.primary: User lands on FlowDocs and understands what is governed, what is still risky, and where to continue.
qualityGates: Hero and sections are Flow documentation patterns.
Editorial backgrounds are tokenized or pattern-owned.
Cards and metadata use Flow surfaces and components.

patternDetails.Section Header: Owns section heading rhythm and hierarchy.
patternDetails.Documentation Hero: Owns docs hero composition and visual slot boundaries.
patternDetails.Documentation Section: Owns docs section spacing, tone, and body layout.
patternDetails.Artifact Metadata Bar: Owns compact metadata rows for system status and route facts.

Docs Collection Template.standard: This template is the collection index surface for FlowDocs and must govern search, filters, metadata, and collection sections through Flow.
Docs Collection Template.screenSystem: Collections expose artifact groups with consistent search, metadata, and section layout across system layers.
Docs Collection Template.informationArchitecture: Content groups by artifact layer and lets users scan, filter, and open details.
Docs Collection Template.primary: User browses a layer of Flow artifacts and needs consistent search, filtering, and metadata.
qualityGates: Collection layout uses Flow documentation sections.
Search and Toolbar own filter behavior.
Artifact metadata is rendered through Artifact Metadata Bar.

patternDetails.Search: Owns query entry and results behavior.

Docs Artifact Detail Template.standard: This template is the generic FlowDocs artifact detail surface and only applies when a more specific detail template is not available.
Docs Artifact Detail Template.screenSystem: The artifact detail surface keeps hero, breadcrumbs, metadata, tabs, body, aside, and footer slots inside one governed Flow boundary.
Docs Artifact Detail Template.informationArchitecture: Content starts with artifact identity and metadata, then moves through tabbed body content, aside support, and footer context.
Docs Artifact Detail Template.primary: User opens a Flow artifact detail page that needs a governed fallback surface without local hero, metadata, tab, or panel wrappers.
qualityGates: Use this template only when no layer-specific foundation, primitive, component, pattern, or template detail template exists.
Hero and metadata are Flow patterns, not local wrappers.
Tabs are composed through Flow Tabs and controlled by consumer state.

patternDetails.Documentation Hero: Owns artifact title, summary, status, actions, and visual treatment boundaries.
patternDetails.Artifact Metadata Bar: Owns compact metadata rows for layer, platform, maturity, status, counts, dependencies, and ownership.

Component Detail Template.standard: This template is the repeated component documentation surface and must keep demos, API, states, variants, and metadata inside governed Flow documentation patterns.
Component Detail Template.screenSystem: Component detail separates overview, demos, state matrices, API, and guidance while preserving shared navigation and metadata.
Component Detail Template.informationArchitecture: Content follows component adoption: understand, inspect variants, test states, consume API, and verify accessibility.
Component Detail Template.primary: Developer or designer inspects a Flow component and needs trustworthy usage, examples, API, and governance status.
qualityGates: Demos use Demo Preview Frame.
Sections use Documentation Section.
Metadata and on-page navigation are Flow patterns.

patternDetails.Demo Preview Frame: Owns demo preview framing and density boundaries.

Pattern Detail Template.standard: This template is the repeated pattern documentation surface and must demonstrate orchestration without recreating component behavior locally.
Pattern Detail Template.screenSystem: Pattern detail separates orchestration intent, dependencies, demos, states, and governance.
Pattern Detail Template.informationArchitecture: Content follows adoption: understand workflow, inspect dependencies, run examples, verify states, and check governance.
Pattern Detail Template.primary: Designer or engineer evaluates a Flow pattern and needs dependency, state, and governance clarity.
qualityGates: Pattern demos use Demo Preview Frame.
Pattern sections use Documentation Section.
Metadata and navigation are Flow patterns.

Reference Detail Template.standard: This template is the shared foundation and primitive reference surface and must keep evidence, examples, and token details governed by Flow.
Reference Detail Template.screenSystem: Reference detail explains foundational intent, primitive contracts, token evidence, and examples without local visual systems.
Reference Detail Template.informationArchitecture: Content moves from intent to token contract to usage evidence.
Reference Detail Template.primary: User inspects a foundation or primitive and needs to know what governs downstream Flow behavior.
qualityGates: Hero and sections are Flow documentation patterns.
Examples use Demo Preview Frame where visual evidence is needed.
Navigation uses On This Page Nav.

Template Detail Template.standard: This template is the repeated product-template documentation surface and must show product modules, dependencies, demos, and governance through Flow.
Template Detail Template.screenSystem: Template detail connects product context, module structure, pattern dependencies, and QA evidence.
Template Detail Template.informationArchitecture: Content moves from template purpose to modules, dependencies, examples, and handoff criteria.
Template Detail Template.primary: User evaluates a product template and needs module, dependency, state, and QA clarity.
qualityGates: Sections use Documentation Section.
Demos use Demo Preview Frame.
Metadata uses Artifact Metadata Bar.
